name: three-camera-fit
goal: The first three.js module: fit a camera to whatever is in the scene, orbit it, and hand it to a real PerspectiveCamera in the order three.js needs. Kris asked for modules in niche tools and other languages; this is also Gordon's first module on the JS harness.

tasks.instructions: No imports and no globals: three.js is never imported, so the module can be tested anywhere; applyTo receives the camera as an argument. The smaller of the vertical and horizontal fields of view limits the fit - compute both. applyTo must call position.set, then set near and far, then lookAt, then updateProjectionMatrix, in that order.
tasks.test_instructions: Walk every table row with a tolerance of 1e-6. Prove a narrow window (aspect below 1) needs a greater distance than a square one, that elevation is clamped at 89 degrees, and that applyTo sets near and far BEFORE updateProjectionMatrix - use a fake camera that records its calls in order.
